$Comment: Bram the Shepherd's daily: eggs for the dough, given and handed in at Bram. The _Harvest_Feast folder
makes the id harvest_feast_shepherd_eggs. Npc binds it to Bram's role, which his placement stands
under in the temple (NpcPlacements/Harvest_Feast_Shepherd_Temple.json), so he offers it from his own
conversation and takes it back, and CompletionDialogue plays his conversation again once it is
collected. Everything else comes from the base: the Season leaf, offered only at the giver, tracked.
It opens once Martha's first quest is done, like her own dailies, so a newcomer meets Martha first.
Repeat.Reset with Period Daily is a calendar daily: it comes back at midnight UTC. A TURN_IN step is
handed in where it is, so no report-back step is added. In the game, eggs come from chickens kept in
a Chicken Coop, and from the odd bird's nest.
It pays like Martha's dailies, through Harvest_Feast_Daily_Pay, with Martha's favor and Festival Favor
on its own Rewards. The Mmo_Xp row is MMO Skill Tree's: Harvesting XP for gathering the eggs, waiting
to be collected with the rest. The row's own Requires, the hytale:mod_installed gate, leaves it out on
a server without that mod, unpaid and unshown, and the rest of the quest pays.
Name: Shepherd_Eggs
